user.title: Pair with Ohmter
user.description: In your Ohmter dashboard open Settings, then Home Assistant, and choose Pair a Home Assistant. Type the code it shows you here. It is valid for ten minutes and works once. No password is needed.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again with Ohmter
reauth_confirm.description: Ohmter disconnected this Home Assistant. Make a new pairing code in your Ohmter dashboard and type it here. Your devices and their history are kept.

error.bad_code: That code is not valid. Check it in your Ohmter dashboard.
error.code_expired: That code has expired. Make a new one in your Ohmter dashboard.
error.cannot_connect: Ohmter could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected happened. Try again in a minute.

abort.already_configured: This Home Assistant is already paired with Ohmter.

menu_options.add_device: Add a device for Ohmter to see
menu_options.edit_device: Change a device's entities or name

add_device.title: What kind of device?
add_device.description: Ohmter controls chargers and thermostats. Meters, inverters and batteries are read only: Ohmter uses them to plan, never to steer.

map_entities.title: Which entities?
map_entities.description: Pick the entities of this {kind} from your Home Assistant. Ohmter only ever receives the entities you choose here. Nothing is switched during setup; the next screen shows what each entity reads right now.

data_description.name: A label. Renaming later keeps the device and its history.
data_description.switch: Optional. On must mean the car may charge, off must stop it. Needed for Ohmter to start and stop charging; without it the charger is monitored only. You confirm this on the next screen.
data_description.power: Required. What the charger draws now, in W or kW. This is how Ohmter sees that charging is happening.
data_description.current: Optional. A number entity for the charger's maximum current in A. Needed for load balancing under your main fuse; without it Ohmter never changes the current.
data_description.energy: Optional. The charger's own session or total energy counter in Wh or kWh. With it, session energy comes from the charger instead of being estimated from power.
data_description.plugged_in: Optional. A binary sensor for whether a car is connected. With it, a start with no car is reported as such rather than as a fault.
data_description.climate: Required. Ohmter reads the current and target temperature from it and, once you confirm control, sets the target during a cheap window and restores it afterwards.
data_description.import_power: Use with export power when the meter has no single net-power sensor.
data_description.export_power: Use with import power when the meter has no single net-power sensor.
data_description.grid_import: Optional. What is actually drawn from the grid.
data_description.grid_export: Optional. What is actually sent to the grid. Without it Ohmter does not guess export from production.
data_description.soc: Required. Battery state of charge in %. Ohmter reads it; it never steers the battery.

confirm_mapping.title: Check before saving

data.confirm_control: I confirm that switching this entity on starts (allows) charging and switching it off stops it, and that Ohmter may do so.

data_description.confirm_control: Leave this off to add the device for monitoring only. You can change it later under Edit.

error.name_too_short: Give the device a name of at least two characters.
error.name_taken: A device with this name already exists.
error.missing_role: This entity is required for the device to work.
error.same_entity_twice: The same entity is picked for two roles.
error.wrong_domain: This entity is the wrong kind for this role (for example a sensor where a switch is needed).
error.wrong_unit: This entity reports a unit Ohmter cannot read as this role (for example V or % where W is needed).
error.not_numeric: This entity's value is not a number.
error.invalid_entity: This entity does not fit this role.

abort.device_gone: That device is no longer in the list.

bridge_revoked.title: Ohmter disconnected this Home Assistant
bridge_revoked.description: This bridge was disconnected from the Ohmter dashboard. Ohmter no longer sends commands. To connect again, make a new pairing code in Ohmter and re-pair the integration.

bridge_conflict.title: Two Home Assistants are using the same Ohmter pairing
bridge_conflict.description: Another Home Assistant instance (a restored backup, perhaps) is reporting with this bridge's token. Ohmter sends no commands until only one remains. Remove the integration from the copy you do not use, then pair this one again.
